name: install-prompt
title: Install Prompt
description: An offer to add the site to the home screen, made once, politely, and only where it can work. Browsers that support it hand over their install dialog (`beforeinstallprompt`), and the Install button opens it. Safari on an iPhone or iPad has no such dialog…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/install-prompt

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/install-prompt.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/install-prompt';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/install-prompt

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
